facts.text: Sam experienced a severe stomachache that required a visit to the ER, which was diagnosed as gastritis.

evidence.quote: I had quite the health scare last weekend - ended up in the ER with a severe stomachache. Turns out, it was gastritis, which was pretty alarming.

facts.text: Sam expressed a desire to prioritize health by adopting a more nutritious diet and getting regular exercise.

evidence.quote: It was a wake-up call for me to start prioritizing my health, like adopting a more nutritious diet and getting regular exercise.

facts.text: Evan mentioned that helping a lost tourist has become a recurring theme in his life.

evidence.quote: I had another encounter with a lost tourist recently. Seems like helping tourists is becoming a recurring theme in my life!

facts.text: Evan suggested setting specific fitness goals and finding an enjoyable exercise with a buddy to stay motivated.

evidence.quote: Set some goals, like a certain distance to run or number of push-ups to do. It'll give you something to strive for and stay motivated. Also, try to find an exercise that you enjoy and maybe even get a buddy for extra fun and accountability.
